notes.title: Early Access September 11 + Playtest & Roadmap!
notes.content:
[b]🎣 Welcome, virtual anglers![/b]

I’m excited to share with you the latest updates about the game, our release plan, and the roadmap for future development.  
📅 [b]The official Early Access launch will take place on September 11.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44279878/ee56355e0d27fa001332084f48ae5936b9a9257e.jpg[/img]

This will still be a developing version – full of improvements, fixes, and new features.  
I want every one of you to have an influence on the game. I carefully read all your suggestions – many of them have been spot-on and were already implemented during the demo phase.  
During Early Access, I will continue listening to your feedback and gladly consider your ideas.

[hr][/hr]

[b]🧪 Playtests before release[/b]  
Soon we will launch the [b]Playtest version[/b], which will involve selected testers as well as streamers and YouTubers.  
Before the official release on [b]September 11[/b], they will show you what the game currently looks like.

⏳ Playtests will run until [b]September 10[/b].  
During this period, we will focus on:  
- 🐟 finding and fixing bugs,  
- ⚙️ improving stability,  
- ✨ adding new features and enhancements.

[b]🎁 Don’t miss your chance![/b]  
On many 📺 [b]Twitch[/b] and 📹 [b]YouTube[/b] channels there will be [b]extra key giveaways[/b] for the Playtest version, allowing you to play the game before release!  
Follow these channels and enable notifications to stay updated – keys will be given away [b]live[/b] during streams and video content.

[hr][/hr]

[b]💬 Official Discord[/b]  
Join the [b]official game Discord server[/b] to find tips, ask questions, and discuss the game with the community.  
https://discord.gg/xhWy44s9zp  

[hr][/hr]

[b]📢 Facebook[/b]  
Follow my Facebook page to stay up to date with game news:  
https://www.facebook.com/MastercodeStudio  

[hr][/hr]

[b]🗺 Game Development Roadmap[/b]  

[b]🔧 Fixes and Improvements[/b]  
- 🛠 Optimization and bug fixing – resolving reported issues and improving game stability.  
- ⚖️ Game balancing and regulations – fine-tuning mechanics and gameplay rules.  
- 🎣 Fishing regulations – introducing limits and realistic fishing rules.  
- 🌅 Visual effects improvements – enhanced lighting, water, vegetation, environment details, plus new surface water effects.  
- 🔊 Sound improvements – more realistic nature, fishing rod, and environment sounds.  
- 🌀 Spinning method improvements – better animations and lure presentation techniques.  
- 🕴 Character animation improvements – smoother movements and more dynamic fishing rod handling.  

[b]🐟 New Content[/b]  
- 🐠 Unique “Oversize” fish – rare, exceptionally large specimens.  
- 🎯 New fishing techniques – e.g., carp fishing and advanced rigs.  
- 📜 New quest types – expansion of Quest Girl missions, tailored to each region.  
- 🏆 Fishing tournaments – qualifiers, semi-finals, and finals.  
- 📅 Global daily competitions – daily challenges with leaderboards.  
- 🗺 New maps – Bug Valley and Vistula Mouth.  
- 🌊 Expansion of existing maps – new fishing spots and bodies of water.  

[b]⚙️ Systems and Mechanics[/b]  
- 🏪 Fishing shop expansion – larger inventory, redesigned interface.  
- 🎒 Advanced inventory system – better loadout management and equipment options.  
- 🪣 Fishing bait creation – mixing ingredients, bait boats.  
- 🎖 Reward system – bonuses for leaderboard placements and unique items.  
- 🏆 Steam Achievements integration – linked with in-game achievements.  

[b]🏕 Additional Features[/b]  
- 🪑 Fishing chairs and umbrellas – fish while sitting.  
- 🔥 Camping options – build campfires and set up camp.  
- 📬 In-game mailbox – receive system messages and send mail to other players.  
- 🤝 Fishing clubs – in-game fishing communities, with cooperation, club tournaments, and inter-club competitions.

[h2]Line Clip Option[/h2]
A new feature has been added that allows players to clip the fishing line in the reel. The line clip lets you set a casting distance—when the rod is cast, you can mark the maximum range of the line, ensuring that on subsequent casts, the bait will not go beyond the set value.

To activate or deactivate the line clip, use the [Left Shift + X] keyboard shortcut.

[h2]Forced Maximum Reel Speed Option[/h2]
While retrieving the line, you can hold [Left Alt] to temporarily increase the reel speed to the maximum. Once the button is released, the speed will return to its previous state.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a new game save system.
[*] Added support for saving the game to the server (Cloud Save).
[*] Added an option to restore game saves (Cloud Save) in the game settings.
[*] Reduced the wear and tear of fishing rods.
[*] Added free repairs for the basic fishing rod and reel.
[*] Increased boat speed by 10%.
[*] Introduced minor graphical improvements.
[*] Changed the font color to orange for distance and bait depth on the UI panel.
[*] Improved ambient sounds, added new sound effects, and changed the duck sounds.
[*] Fixed a bug where the option to hide network notifications in the game settings was not working.
[*] Improved the NPC for quests – reduced the frequency of spoken lines.
[*] Improved the casting reticle, making it more intense and visible at night.
[*] Improved nighttime lighting – increased the brightness of the moonlight.
[*] Fixed other minor bugs.
[/list]

[h2]NOTICE: New Game Save System[/h2]
A completely new, safer, and more efficient game save system has been introduced. After this update, the tent position will be reset.

This is a necessary change that still requires testing, so please be patient if something does not work correctly on the first launch.

[h2]Cloud Save System:[/h2]
The game now automatically saves every 20 seconds both locally and on the server.
Up to 15 game sessions are stored on the server, allowing you to revert progress to one of the last 15 sessions.
The game can be played on multiple devices (computers) linked to the same Steam account.

notes.title: Big Update for Professional Fishing 2 Demo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44279878/76206422a1c56f344fadddac5aa7db9084e81996.jpg[/img]

Hello, dear virtual anglers!

I am excited to announce the release of my latest, long-awaited update for the Professional Fishing 2 Demo! I have prepared a lot of changes, including many based on your suggestions from surveys and messages. Your feedback is extremely valuable to me, and every change was made to make the game even better and more tailored to your expectations.

I hope the new version will meet your expectations and provide many hours of great fun! However, this is the first update of this scale, which means that some bugs may occur. I will fix them quickly, so I kindly ask for your patience and for you to report any problems you notice. Your suggestions are always welcome, as they help me shape the future of the game.

What's new in this update?
[list]
[*] New graphics engine – the game now looks better than ever! The new visual quality makes fishing even more realistic.

[*] New selectable characters and customization – you can create your own angler and customize their appearance to your liking.

[*] New location: Forest Lake – a beautiful, natural scenery with several separate fishing spots, offering even more opportunities to explore.

[*] More gear and accessories in the shop – I have expanded the catalog with new models of rods, baits, reels, and much more.

Your feedback is crucial to me, so I invite you to share it in the comments and report any remarks regarding the update. Your suggestions help me continuously improve Professional Fishing 2, and every piece of your advice matters!

I can't wait to hear your impressions of the game. See you by the water, and tight lines!

Hello, dear anglers!

It's been a while since I last shared any updates on the progress of Professional Fishing 2. But it's time to change that! I want to reassure you – the game is actively being developed, and work on improvements is ongoing.

Soon, you'll be able to test an updated demo version, where you'll see significant changes. Among the most important new features, you'll find:

notes.title: Professional Fishing 2: Demo Feedback and Early Access Plans
notes.content:
Dear Players!

It's been a week since the release of the Professional Fishing 2 demo. I would like to sincerely thank everyone who played the demo, filled out the survey in the game, and provided ratings and feedback. I am very pleased with the number of players who participated in the demo and the ratings I received in the surveys. Over 3000 people have played the demo, and it has received an overall rating of 3.8/5.

You might be wondering why I'm not engaging in discussions with you here on Steam and not responding to your questions. I want you to know that I don't have much time to participate in discussions as I'm focused on developing the game. However, I do check and read your opinions and thoughts from time to time.

I want to emphasize that your opinions and suggestions are crucial to me. They often hold valuable insights, so I strive to consider them during the game development process. However, the final decisions regarding the game's development will be based on my vision and plan. I am a one-person studio, handling programming, graphics, sound, and all other aspects of game production by myself. Therefore, I ask for your understanding and patience.

I take all of your opinions and suggestions into account, and I make changes and improvements based on them. I want to create a game that I would personally love to play. I will keep you updated on the progress and new features in the game.

The demo version will receive one more update with improvements, but there won't be any additional content added. The demo is a limited version of the game meant to showcase its core features and help you make an informed decision before potentially purchasing the full version.

Let me address some frequently asked questions about the demo:

[list]
[*] "The float is not very visible; please add a float zoom option." 
In the game settings (Settings->Game), there is an option to scale the float, set by default to 5. You should increase this value to make the float more visible.
[/list]
[list]
[*] "The fishing line shortens after each cast." 
In reality, the fishing line doesn't shorten, but in the game, it is related to maintaining the game's economic balance. Items need to be consumed so that players have something to spend their money on. The shortening of the fishing line is a representation of its wear.
[/list]
[list]
[*] "The fishing gear wears out too quickly." 
I will reduce the rate at which items wear out to address this.
[/list]
[list]
[*] "The fish are too small." 
In the demo, larger fish also appear. You need to adjust the length of the leader for float fishing, fish at greater water depths, keep the bait closer to the bottom when spinning, use the right bait for the fishing spot, and explore various locations as fish come in different species and sizes in different areas of the water.
[/list]
[list]
[*] "I receive too little experience and money for catching fish." 
The game is designed to provide a challenge. To gain experience and money more quickly, you should complete as many quests and tasks as possible. The tasks are not difficult, and there is plenty of time to complete them. In future versions of the game, additional methods of gaining experience and money will be introduced.
[/list]
[list]
[*] "There's no tutorial." 
The tutorial is available before starting the game in the Help->How to Play section. There, you can find basic information on how to operate the game. As new techniques and options are added, the "How to Play" guide will be expanded. Make sure to also familiarize yourself with the list of controls in the Settings->Controls section.
[/list]

Currently, I'm working hard on the early access version of the game, planned for release in October this year. This version will include:

[list]
[*] An expanded map of Central Europe with additional regions, rivers, backwaters, lakes, and ponds.
[*] A world map.
[*] Character customization and personalization options.
[*] Basic multiplayer features, such as the visibility of other players and communication between them.
[*] The feeder fishing method.
[*] Bait and groundbait mechanics.
[*] Sonars and echo sounders.
[*] An expanded assortment of fishing gear in the fishing shop, including various types of rods, reels, baits, and other accessories.
[*] Watercraft: boats, pontoons, and motorboats.
[*] Land vehicles: quads.
[*] Leaderboards for the best players.
[*] Achievements.
[/list]

During the early access phase, I also plan to:

[list]
[*] Expand the map of Central Europe with additional regions, including Western and Eastern Europe, as well as Scandinavia.
[*] Introduce the fly fishing method.
[*] Further develop the fishing shop's assortment.
[*] Add additional watercraft and land vehicles.
[*] Introduce public transportation.
[*] Enhance the multiplayer mode with fishing duels and competitions.
[*] Implement hunting elements.
[/list]

I hope you will enjoy the game in the next version and that it will bring you much joy. Thank you for your support and valuable feedback, which helps me improve the game.

With respect,
MasterCode
